changes.explanation: The vulnerable version compiles user input as a Mako template. Mako evaluates ${expr} as arbitrary Python expressions and <%...%> blocks as Python statements with no sandboxing. Any Python builtin or importable module is accessible, making RCE trivial with __import__('os'). The hardened version rejects any input containing Mako syntax delimiters (${, <%, %>, <%!, ##) and uses a pre-compiled static template where user input is the 'value' variable, HTML-escaped via the | h filter.
